extracted.intended_audience: readers and scholars seeking public-domain translations of Quintilian's Institutio Oratoria / general readers of classical rhetoric
extracted.subtask_description: A bibliographic/wiki page listing editions and translations of Quintilian's Institutio Oratoria (Institutes of Oratory), aimed at locating public-domain texts and related metadata. It is not a how-to or evaluative guideline but a catalog-style entry.
